waveSysLines.line: 📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1 is halfway there (3/5 kills — the ledger counts kills only, not near-misses).
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1's bar is full (5/5 — kills only, not near-misses).
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 CONTEST: The Pit. Thrown into an arena with a wave-appropriate beast. Kill or be killed. The audience votes on weapons.
📺 The Pit. Thrown into an arena with a wave-appropriate beast. Kill or be killed. The audience votes on weapons.

📺 The Pit. Thrown into an arena with a wave-appropriate beast. Kill or be killed. The audience votes on weapons.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The arena floor is sand and old bone. The gate across from yo

📺 The gate slams up. A wave-appropriate beast comes out low and fast — it has been promised food.

It circles. It's deciding how you die.

This is a real fight now. Your weapon, your health, your call — the grid is the arena.
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 2 is halfway there (2/4 kills — the ledger counts kills only, not near-misses).
📺 Wave 1: The lead falls — the pack's coordination shatters. The rest scatter or die. (1 rounds, 3 taken)
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 2's bar is full (4/4 — kills only, not near-misses). Wave 3 opens once day 25 passes.
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 3 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 CONTEST: Beastmaster. Ride a collared wave-2 beast through the obstacle course. Guide it. Do not hurt it. It remembers.
📺 Beastmaster. Ride a collared wave-2 beast through the obstacle course. Guide it. Do not hurt it. It remembers.

📺 Beastmaster. Xavier has been taken.

A wave-2 beast in a light-collar, pacing. The course: rings of fire, a balance beam over spikes, a tunnel.

The System: "RIDE. GUIDE. DO NOT HURT IT. IT REMEMBERS." Xavier mounts like it's a horse that could kill you. It could.
